name: dsh-html-panel
description: 大管家 (Butler Console): a DSH sidebar entry that opens a standalone HTML console page served by this plugin's own Host route and shown in an iframe. Three columns — five-page navigation (butler/tasks/cluster/memory/settings), a DSH-style conversation page whose composer hosts real quick actions, and a right-hand T0→T1→T2→T3 dispatch hierarchy built from live sessions, real subagent lineage (session origin/parentSession, plus the official subagent address {parentSessionId, childSessionId, mode}) and interconnect.list() for peers. 0.5.0: api/board additionally returns TeamTaskView-shaped mesh tasks and a read-only official Agent Teams projection (agentTeam, honest {available:false, reason} degradation); the butler page answers the official three questions and renders task/hierarchy cards from the official contracts. 0.6.0: the TRAIL (MIT) failure taxonomy (21 leaf categories, names unchanged) is embedded in lib/trail.js with a rule-based classifier (10 rules over real mesh board / tiers / official fields, no LLM, no network) exposed as the read-only route api/alerts; the butler page's first question is driven by alerts (needs-you count with evidence-backed cards, honest 'nothing needs you' empty state) and tasks that hit an alert get a clickable flag. Same-origin read-only routes: api/cluster, api/board, api/host, api/tiers, api/alerts; the only write path is POST api/action with a whitelisted action id.
